_about: PARKED. The Anti-hero's first real moveset (M0) at the rich end: plan in ../m0-rich.md. Not loaded, not hashed, no schema yet. Every id is a working label: Narrative names what shows on screen and Legal screens it. Numbers that are Game Design's are quoted, not set, here.

noRepeat._note: The longest run of blows by one fighter is 3 in an exchange plus 5 chain links. After any one broken limb, in the air and on the ground, the pool must still hold stringBlows distinct lights and heaviesMin distinct heavies, so no key strike repeats inside a string.

limbRules.uses: what a piece needs: arms 1 (either arm; the mirror is free) or 2; legs 1 (the striking leg) or 2; head; own (the fighter's own limb).
limbRules.ground: ok: plays in the air and on the ground. plant: on the ground it also needs the other leg to stand on. only: ground only. no: air only.
limbRules.brokenArm: pieces with arms 2 are dropped; arms 1 play on the good arm; two arm strikes never run back to back.
limbRules.brokenLeg: pieces with legs 2 are dropped; in the air legs 1 play on the good leg; on the ground every piece marked plant or only is dropped.

poses._note: fired from the shards that circle him: no hands
the energy context fallback: pushback only

energy._note: an energy strike is an emitter (a strike with 'emits', or an energy pose) and one of its shapes; the shape sets the weight.

entries._note: from the ground with a broken leg: the slow take-off, then this
the golden-spiral flight (blitz.md); also the ping-pong intercept
uncoils out of the crouch, off the ground or a wall
drops into the crouch and strikes from it
a sidestep in depth, once fight lanes land
no step: he strikes from where he stands or hovers
a lean back out of range and a counter: no step
drops low under the blow, counters from the crouch

feints._note: a look away: the look-at layer plays it

grabs._note: a grab on the end of a rush
half a turn carrying the body, then the release: also the director's throw at a brunt target behind him (launch-vectors.md section 5)

taunts._note: a slow tilt of the masked head, from the crouch

pulse._note: Game Design's rule (rule-of-cool.md section 2). One big set piece every 20 s; a second inside it plays as its ordinary version.

fist_clash.trigger: a heavy meets a heavy (HEAVY CLASH's clash branch)
beats: 0: both heavies meet on their contact tick; lock
84: the winner's blow goes through as an ender and launches; scores that differ by less than 10: both are thrown back (today's shockwave)
fist_clash.pieces: composed: each fighter's own heavy piece, the lock, the winner's ender

blur_exchange.trigger: both attacking with strings queued, Tense or Frenzied, tier 2 and up
beats: each burst: three alternating light blows at 6-tick spacing while the pair travels, then the pulse blow
84: the winner's ender lands and launches
blur_exchange.pieces: composed from the light pool; every blow is a drawn contact pose held 4 ticks or more

grapple_lock.trigger: two grabs meet in the air, or a dive grab meets a grab
beats: 102: the winner throws the loser down (drive_down or spike)
grapple_lock.pieces: the hold both ways, three strain poses, a throw

beats: a launch he caused, then an attack held toward
the spiral intercept: he arrives ahead of the body and turns
a return blow (class return): x0.6 of a light
the ender (class ender): a heavy, and the only blow that may be a targeted smash
ping_pong.pieces: return blows from the light pool tagged return; the ender from the heavy pool; one authored turn pose

beats: the held direction picks the throw
turn throw: 2 more of hold, 8 of turn, then the release

beam_answers.trigger: a perfect block against a signature; the direction held picks the look (rule-of-cool.md section 2)

away._look: a backhand sweep with the good arm; the beam is knocked aside

neutral._look: he turns side-on and the beam parts on his plated spine and shoulder

toward._look: he walks through it upright, hands open, and arrives in front of the attacker

taunt.punish: a hit during it is a clean hit at x1.2

on_the_chin._note: spec-wounds.md section 3. Built after his first moveset.

last_stand._note: no pause; a camera cut, the face cut-in and a line

fixed: the barrage until the loser gives way (volleys scale with Pride)
generative: the last blow: a heavy piece he can still throw

fixed: no barrage: a scramble of four or five blows
a two-hand drive into the ground
generative: the drive: one-handed if an arm is broken

fixed: he stands still for a long beat

specials.what: both hands fan a spread of bolts in a long arc (Animation's S1)
a short vertical dash ending in a sweeping strike (S2)
a grab at speed, a drag along the ground, a throw (S3)
hangs a line of shards in the air that burst when the rival crosses it
springs from the crouch into a rising shoulder and a tail lash
a wide scatter that herds the rival, then one charged shot down the gap
a counter: catches the striking arm after a block and answers with a point-blank burst
a volley fired upward that comes down along a line a second later

signatures.what: a slam that sends bolts along the ground (G2)
a dive that opens a fan of shards beneath him
Regalia's own: the doubled ring thrown as two rolling waves
Sovereign's own: the hanging plates fire as a fixed arc
revealed the first time he takes Apex (G4)
a rivalry thread's reveal: later, Narrative's trigger

showcases.what: a toying strike with a taunt pause (W1)
the Proud front collapsing in one beat (W2)
one driven lash of the tail (W5)
rakes both forearm guards across in a double cut (Regalia and up)
a full crouch, a beat of stillness, one uncoiling blow
turns his back mid-string and strikes with the tail without looking
catches an ankle and drags a line in the ground before the throw
three rising knees that climb the body
gathers the circling shards on one fist for a single heavy (Sovereign and up)
a half bow that is a headbutt
a ground sweep that scoops into the rising launch
a four-limb scramble ending in a two-hand drive (Abdicate only)
only with a broken arm: he tucks it behind his back and fights with the other as if by choice
